description: This file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application, which handles search intents, manages a search view in the action bar, and interacts with loader callbacks to query a contacts database.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity manages search intents, initializes the UI, and interacts with loaders to query contact data based on user input.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and processes the intent if present.

methods.name: onNewIntent
methods.description: Handles new intents received while the activity is running.

methods.name: handleIntent
methods.description: Processes incoming intents, especially search actions, and triggers data loading.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Sets up the options menu, including configuring the search view.
